summary.text: Gina Oswald, a certified write-in independent candidate listed by Spectrum News as living in Strong, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. Senate in Maine to Troy Jackson, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
No campaign website, statements or Ballotpedia survey were found.

sources.title: Maine's U.S. Senate race to include 6 write-in candidates, triggering ranked-choice voting
